status_source: This file is the canonical task status; roadmap and archived proposals do not override it.

tasks.title: Consolidate the design workspace
tasks.exit: All twelve concepts, prompts, reference proposals and current planning documents are linked locally.

tasks.exit: Record representative hardware/workloads and numeric latency, idle, memory, asset, instance, recipe and cache limits.

tasks.exit: Verify font styles/digit shaping, standard panel orientation, unavailable-capability states and the native component path; document limits.

Full rendering/provider/layout integration, finished presets and package acceptance remain later tasks.

tasks.exit: Clock and Weather use the same measured presentation inputs in desktop and preview; previews cannot perform live actions.

Provider deduplication, complete layout/transaction integration, physical output transitions, final presets and package qualification remain later tasks.

tasks.title: Isolate provider demand and typed snapshots
tasks.exit: Same-key consumers share work; different keys remain separate; stale/cancelled delivery and hidden-consumer demand are controlled.
tasks.validation_scope: Clock/Weather first slice: bounded keyed Weather work, reference demand, cancellation acknowledgement, generation-fenced typed delivery, accepted/coalesced cache writes and a shared Clock observation. 123 distinct focused regressions (18 new), including production HTTP parser on loopback and isolated runtime/display/native-view checks. Other providers, complete integration, real presentation timing, live providers and package acceptance remain separate.

No separate persistence owner. Fresh compositor/performance/physical acceptance remains FB09/FB20. Implementation review correction validated: hide the shared column during Arrange even with Weather disabled.

tasks.exit: Real desktop/preview Clock and Weather, two styles, isolated duplicate demand, Undo, crash/stale-work and display-change cases meet QUALITY.md and BUDGETS.md; measure real input-to-present/frame pacing, memory cycles and cold asset cancellation separately from draw/readback.
tasks.validation_scope: 161 distinct regressions, six new; bounded cancellable scene/color workers; native input/frame pacing, edit/Undo memory cycles, 60-second idle, actual desktop and paired maximum standalone workload; 368 GPU/software proxy samples. Physical devices, live providers and exact packages remain FB20.
